The World Bank says the Lao treasury received over $170 million in 2010-2017 and that 97% of households doubled their money income, without saying who measured this, and no independent check was found. The project's Panel of Experts heard of falling incomes in all but one of a small number of household interviews in 2010, and International Rivers and Mekong Watch, both campaign groups, reported in 2018 that incomes had risen overall but unevenly and that revenue reports were not published.
nam-theun-2.searched: World Bank project overview, Panel of Experts 17th report (2010, qualitative interviews only), International Rivers/Mekong Watch. The 27th and final Panel report is reported as unreleased, so no independent income measure was found.

About a third of people still have no electricity, and the dam's operator has arrears of about 70 billion francs.

IMF targets were "easily fulfilled" in 1979, and Rosemary Thorp's Wilson Center paper concludes that abrupt orthodox stabilisation did not suit Peru's economy.

adani-mundra-mangroves-fishers.whole: India's national auditor found the Adani Group under-used 87% (5,639 hectares) of the land it bought from the state, and that its Mundra zone was among the low performers, according to Business Today (2014). In a sample of a dozen units, only 42,000 of a projected 1.247 million jobs appeared. No Mundra-only job figure was found.
adani-mundra-mangroves-fishers.searched: Business Today report of the CAG audit. Port throughput and power output not opened.

sources_add.title: CAG report on Gujarat SEZs

eacop-bank-protest-arrests.whole: The pipeline has carried no oil yet: its company reported it 92.7% complete in August 2026, with over 12,000 direct jobs, over 4,000 of them held by Ugandans. TotalEnergies told Der Tagesspiegel this and its related oil field would create 80,000 direct and indirect jobs, about 3,000 of them long-term. Uganda's petroleum regulator says about a quarter of $3.5 billion invested in the sector stayed in the country; no independent check was found.
eacop-bank-protest-arrests.searched: EACOP company page, Tagesspiegel investigation citing TotalEnergies and Petroleum Authority of Uganda.

sources_add.title: Uganda's Minister of Energy and Mineral Development visits EACOP Pump Station 1
EACOP pipeline through East Africa: Who profits from the new oil?

essar-mahan-singrauli.whole: The 1,200 MW plant's owner went into insolvency, and Adani Power bought it in March 2022 for over Rs 4,250 crore (Business Standard). No figure for power generated, jobs or benefit to Singrauli villages was found.
essar-mahan-singrauli.searched: Business Standard. Global Energy Monitor page would not load.

sources_add.title: Adani Power completes acquisition of Essar's 1,200 MW Mahan project in MP

omkareshwar-reservoir-raising.whole: The operator, NHPC, says the 520 MW dam has a design output of 1,166 million units a year and started in November 2007, and that it can irrigate about 283,000 hectares a year. No independent figure for power generated or land actually irrigated was found.
omkareshwar-reservoir-raising.searched: NHPC project page. CAG Madhya Pradesh overview redirected to a page that was not opened.

sources_add.title: Omkareshwar (JV)

zuari-cottonseed-child-labour.whole: About 4,000 small farms grew cottonseed for the company in 2012, about 2% of India's output, and the farms surveyed averaged 0.2 hectares (Norway's Council on Ethics). The Council gives no figures for farm income or wages from Zuari, and no independent study of benefit to these farmers was found.
zuari-cottonseed-child-labour.searched: Council on Ethics recommendation. Company did not report income figures.

sources_add.title: Recommendation on Zuari Agro Chemicals
sources_add.publisher: Council on Ethics, Government Pension Fund Global (Norway)

hidrosogamoso-jbic-impregilo.whole: Builder Webuild says the 820 MW plant generates an average of 5,056 GWh a year, about 10% of Colombia's annual need, and that construction employed 7,000 people. No independent check of output or of benefit to river communities was found.
hidrosogamoso-jbic-impregilo.searched: Webuild project page. Colombian regulator's seguimiento page not opened.

sources_add.title: Sogamoso Hydroelectric Project

jirau-dam-esbr-madeira.whole: Lead shareholder Engie said in 2015 that the 3,750 MW dam would meet the electricity demand of 10 million Brazilian households and cut emissions by 6 million tons a year. Its carbon credit application claimed about 6.2 million tons of avoided emissions a year; scientist Philip Fearnside argued these were not real, because the dam was already being built. No independent measure of power delivered or of benefit to Rondônia was found.
jirau-dam-esbr-madeira.searched: Engie newsroom, Fearnside comments via River Resource Hub.

sources_add.title: Philip Fearnside Comments on Jirau Dam (Brazil)
Jirau hydro power plant in Brazil achieves full assured energy

ocp-pipeline-westlb-spills.whole: The $1.5 billion pipeline was built to carry 450,000 barrels of heavy crude a day. In 2017 Argus reported it was carrying about 170,000, roughly 38% of capacity, while the owners kept paying under contract whether oil moved or not; its operating contract ran to 2023.
ocp-pipeline-westlb-spills.searched: Argus Media. No figure on revenue to Ecuador or later throughput opened.

sources_add.title: Ecuador heavy oil pipeline could revert to state

united-cacao-pucallpa-uchunya.whole: By early 2017 United Cacao appeared near financial collapse, according to the Forest Peoples Programme, a group that advocates for affected communities: its shares were suspended in London, it was selling machinery to fund operations, and it planned to cut plantation staff from 450 to 250. No figure for benefit to Ucayali communities was found.
united-cacao-pucallpa-uchunya.searched: Forest Peoples Programme (an advocate for affected communities). No output figure found.

sources_add.title: Melka resigns from United Cacao as company faces financial crisis and delisting in London

tiaa-matopiba-farmland-grilagem.whole: The money bought farmland to rent out and later sell at a higher price. Chain Reaction Research found nine properties entirely or partly leased to a soy producer and, citing partner Cosan, reported net profit of BRL 250 million in 2018 across the three entities. Radar says it brings jobs, infrastructure and small projects to the region; the report gives no job figures, and no independent count was found.
tiaa-matopiba-farmland-grilagem.searched: Chain Reaction Research company report via Aidenvironment. No employment data found.

sources_add.title: Radar company report

kinangop-wind-park-shooting.whole: The 60.8 MW wind farm, costing about $147 million, was to supply about 150,000 homes by 2018. It was cancelled in February 2016 and never completed, with the developer saying project funds were used up; Norfund later wrote off its Sh1 billion stake.

sources_add.title: Kenya: Kinangop power project cancelled over land disputes
Norfund writes off Sh1bn investment in Kinangop wind farm

lake-turkana-wind-land.whole: The 310 MW wind farm supplies Kenya's national grid. Because the power line reached it 21 months late, taxpayers faced about Ksh 18.5 billion in delay payments, and consumers pay a higher tariff until May 2024 under the settlement, according to a parliamentary special audit reported by Vellum. No independent figure for benefit to Sarima's residents was found.
lake-turkana-wind-land.searched: Vellum report of Public Investments Committee special audit, Business Daily. Share of national generation not opened.

sources_add.title: Kenyans shoulder a heavy burden in the largest Public-Private Partnership project
Idle Turkana wind power costs taxpayers Sh18bn

sime-darby-liberia-graves.whole: Of a 220,000-hectare concession, Sime Darby planted about 10,300 hectares in ten years, by its own account. It reported operating losses of $19 million in 2018 and $16 million in 2019, then sold the operation in 2019-20 for $1 in cash plus possible later payments. No total job count or independent measure of local benefit was found.
sime-darby-liberia-graves.searched: Sime Darby statement via FrontPage Africa, Bernama via Malay Mail.

sources_add.title: Sime Darby finally shuts down, leaves Liberia

cirebon-1-coal-kanci.whole: The 660 MW plant in West Java is now due to close by 2035, seven years early. A local group, RAPEL, says about 300 people work there and around 50 are from neighbouring Kanci Kulon, mostly in security and cleaning (Eco-Business). No independent study of local benefit was found, and CREA estimates early closure would prevent 6,370 deaths in 2036-2042.

sources_add.title: Indonesia's first early coal retirement raises concerns over labour rights and environmental damage compensation

obi-kawasi-nickel-hpal.whole: Agung Satriyo Nugroho of Gadjah Mada University told a Bisnis Indonesia forum in 2024 that a survey found Kawasi's shops rose from 17 in 2014 to 152 in 2024 and its restaurants from none to 38, with population and built-up land roughly doubled since 2016, which he links to migration. The report does not say who ran or paid for the survey or give household incomes, and no independent check was found.
obi-kawasi-nickel-hpal.searched: Bisnis Indonesia. No figure for household income or workers found.

sources_add.title: Hilirisasi Nikel di Pulau Obi Bikin Ekonomi Desa Sekitar Tumbuh 2 Kali Lipat

golden-veroleum-sinoe-palm.whole: Golden Veroleum holds a 65-year concession of 350,000 hectares. It said it employed nearly 4,000 Liberians in 2015 and cut 443 jobs in 2020, over 10% of its workforce. James Otto of the Sustainable Development Institute says such promises are unrealistic, and no independent count of jobs or income was found.
golden-veroleum-sinoe-palm.searched: New Dawn report of company press release, New Narratives/FrontPage Africa.

sources_add.title: GVL employs over 90 Liberians
Palm Oil Plantation Lays Off Nearly 450 Workers Blaming Economic Downturn

korindo-papua-forest-clearing.whole: Korindo says it runs 28 schools with about 200 teachers and free clinics, and that its Asiki hospital treated 37,515 patients in 2018. Its statement gives no job figures, and no independent check of these claims was found.
korindo-papua-forest-clearing.searched: Korindo statement on FSC report. No independent evaluation of its services found.

sources_add.title: Korindo statement on FSC public report

tap-albania-land-compensation.whole: The pipeline carries gas across Albania toward Italy. Oxford Economics forecast 2,900 direct jobs a year during construction and about €780 million added to GDP over 50 years of operation (Natural Gas World, 2016, an article promoting the pipeline that does not say who paid for the study). These are forecasts, and no later count of actual jobs, taxes or gas supplied to Albanians was found.
tap-albania-land-compensation.searched: Natural Gas World citing Oxford Economics, Top Channel. No measured results found.

sources_add.title: How TAP Helps its Transit Countries

btc-pipeline-ardahan-turkey.whole: Turkey's energy minister said in 2014 that the state oil company, with a 6.5% stake, had earned $12 billion from the pipeline since 2005, with over 1.8 billion barrels carried. No independent check of that figure, and no figure for benefit to Ardahan villages, was found.
btc-pipeline-ardahan-turkey.searched: Hurriyet Daily News. IFC press page and fact-finding reports not used for benefit.

sources_add.title: Turkey 'earns $12 billion' from Baku pipeline

hsbc-sarawak-logging-loans.whole: The campaign group Global Witness estimates HSBC earned about $130 million in interest and fees from seven Sarawak logging groups, and says the region has about 5% of its forest left intact. No figure for jobs or income to Sarawak's people from these loans was found.
hsbc-sarawak-logging-loans.searched: Global Witness archive page. No company reply or independent benefit data on that page.

sources_add.title: HSBC rakes in US$130 million bankrolling rainforest destruction and human rights abuses in Malaysia

westpac-wtk-turubu-png.whole: PNG's Supreme Court found the Turubu oil palm lease invalid in August 2016. In 2018 RNZ reported the company "ostensibly" running oil palm there under a new permit, which the forestry minister called landowner-led and a landowner said few landowners had approved. No figure for planting, jobs or income to landowners was found.
westpac-wtk-turubu-png.searched: RNZ 2018 and 2016. Oxfam report itself not opened.

sources_add.title: Loggers still operating on PNG lease despite court ruling

indofood-lonsum-bank-financing.searched: Searched Indofood Agri statements, RAN, Jakarta Post. Indofood Agri cites RSPO audits by SAI Global that found its units compliant, but gives no job, wage or income figures, and the bank money was for general company use. Nothing on benefit found. Re-searched once; results listed nothing on benefit (result lists only).

para-beef-banks-sao-felix.whole: São Félix do Xingu holds Brazil's largest cattle herd, about 2.3 million animals, more than tripled since 2000, per an article carried by The Nature Conservancy, which runs a project there. One rancher reported a gain of R$2 per arroba, and the article gives no job figures. No independent study of what the bank money did for people there was found.
para-beef-banks-sao-felix.searched: EXAME article via TNC. General Amazon studies are left out as not specific to this case.

sources_add.title: More Profits and Less Destruction (EXAME article)

dabhol-enron-guhagar.whole: The World Bank turned down funding in 1993, calling the project "not economically viable" (Human Rights Watch). Phase I (740 MW) began in May 1999; the state board agreed to about Rs 2.8 a unit but in effect paid over Rs 7, and the plant had stood idle from May 2001, after the board stopped buying, when the Observer Research Foundation wrote in 2004.
dabhol-enron-guhagar.searched: HRW 1999 report, Observer Research Foundation 2004. PARI page had no readable text.

sources_add.title: The Enron Corporation: Corporate Complicity in Human Rights Violations, background
Reviving Dabhol

punta-catalina-bndes-sace.whole: The 752 MW coal plant was to cost $1.945 billion, and a budget expert calculated over $2.3 billion spent by July 2018. Grid operator figures in September 2021 show about 618 MW on one afternoon, four trips off the grid that month and three days at half capacity (Diario Libre). No study of savings for consumers was found.
punta-catalina-bndes-sace.searched: Diario Libre 2018 and 2021. Figures on share of national generation not opened.

sources_add.title: Calculan que el costo de Punta Catalina ya supera US$2,300 MM
A mas de un ano de inaugurada, Punta Catalina sigue operando con altibajos

pomio-rimbunan-hijau-police.whole: Rimbunan Hijau has claimed 4,000 local jobs, K50 million in wages and 1,000 km of roads at West Pomio, with oil palm on 14,000 hectares. Resource owners answer that fewer than 200 local people are employed, fewer than 15 of them resource owners, and that the roads mainly serve the company (Act Now PNG, a campaign group, 2017). No independent count was found.
pomio-rimbunan-hijau-police.searched: Act Now PNG report of claims and reply.

sources_add.title: Resource owners in West Pomio SABL say they have not benefited as claimed by RH

tbla-dgs-mufg-danamon-peat.whole: The company grows palm oil and sugar, with a 9,000-hectare cane plantation feeding a mill designed for 8,000 tons of cane a day in 2017 (Indonesia Investments). It did not answer reporters on the RAN findings, and no figures for jobs or local income were found.
tbla-dgs-mufg-danamon-peat.searched: Indonesia Investments, Eco-Business. Company sustainability report not opened.

sources_add.title: Indonesian Plantation Firms in Focus: Tunas Baru Lampung
Japanese bank flouts peatlands pledge by funding notorious Indonesian palm oil firm: study

enb-tobar-maybank-watwat.whole: ENB says former cocoa and copra workers were offered jobs on its estates, without giving a number. Global Witness reports the land had been part of a $50 million World Bank smallholder project, and that 120 households from that scheme were evicted, with no compensation reported. No figures for jobs or income were found.
enb-tobar-maybank-watwat.searched: Global Witness, The True Price of Palm Oil (includes company reply).

sources_add.title: The True Price of Palm Oil

hongsa-lignite-thai-banks.whole: The 1,878 MW plant sells most of its power to Thailand, with 1,473 MW set aside for Thailand's utility and 100 MW for Laos (Global Energy Monitor). In 2015 it sold 1,522 GWh to Thailand and 8.46 GWh to Laos, and the Lao government expected over $2.3 billion in taxes over 25 years (Vientiane Times). No independent check of taxes paid was found.
hongsa-lignite-thai-banks.searched: Global Energy Monitor, Vientiane Times via Vietstock.

Hongsa power plant earns over US$16.8 million to date
